The structure of Ce₄Al₈Ni₄ (reduced formula CeAl₂Ni) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: Al centers have 8 geometric neighbors (4 Al, 2 Ce, 2 Ni), while Ce and Ni centers each have 8 Al neighbors, with neighbor distances from 3.0328 to 3.0335 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show Al–Al 8-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Ce–Ni pairs share corners and faces.
